rules: P2 DECISION-AUTHORITY.md §3 A1-A9 with the §5 v0.2 changes C1-C5

decisions.statement: run-interest charges, once per invoice, collection interest of 1% of the invoice amount (rounded to the cent, half away from zero) on every invoice where today is later than due date + 60 days and something is still outstanding; the interest is added to what is outstanding and therefore to the customer's balance.
'Still unpaid' is read the same way the existing late-fee rule reads it: something is still outstanding on the invoice (Rules.outstanding > 0).

Collection interest is charged on invoices of nonprofit customers too. The existing 'nonprofit accounts are not chased' filter (Rules.chased) is applied only to late fees and has no decision record; DEC-B14 and BILL-43-R1 say 'every invoice that owes it', so no exception is applied. Flagged as an open question.

Interest is stored as a new Interest field on the Invoice record (0 until charged); show keeps its exact existing format, so the interest is visible only through the outstanding figure and the balance.
reasons: A2 'docs/architecture.md' does not resolve to a requirement, decision record or approval

decisions.statement: run-interest is added to the help/usage list directly after run-late-fees, and to the README command list in the same position.
